note: Single source of truth for the app's permanent product links. The app ships linkBase + path and never changes; each page below is regenerated from this file by affiliate-links/build-pages.py into docs/go/<slug>/index.html and published by GitHub Pages. Edit 'destination' and 'merchant', run the script, commit, push — no app build. 'destination' is null until an approved affiliate URL exists; a null route writes no page and the app hides that product's button. Provider-independent on purpose: the same paths can be rebuilt on any host from this file alone.

routes.name: Rosemary oil
routes.summary: The strongest natural topical — a 6-month trial matched minoxidil 2% for regrowth, with less itch.

routes.name: Ketoconazole shampoo
routes.summary: A medicated shampoo that improves density as an anti-inflammatory adjunct; best evidence is for 2%.

routes.name: Saw palmetto
routes.summary: A plant DHT-blocker with several positive trials — real, but clearly milder than finasteride.

routes.name: Pumpkin seed oil
routes.summary: One trial showed a large count gain — but the capsule was a blend, so it can't all be pinned on pumpkin oil.

routes.name: Melatonin (topical)
routes.summary: A positive pilot trial plus many open-label reports; promising but not yet high-quality evidence.

routes.name: Marine protein complex
routes.summary: Viviscal/Nourkrin-type complexes have real placebo-controlled trials — but all are manufacturer-funded.

routes.name: Caffeine (topical)
routes.summary: Broadly positive but low-quality trials; safe to use as a supporting active.

routes.name: Procapil / Redensyl
routes.summary: Cosmeceutical actives with some controlled data — but on soft, bias-prone endpoints.

routes.name: Green tea / EGCG
routes.summary: Only lab-dish evidence for hair growth so far — no controlled human trial.

routes.name: Peppermint oil
routes.summary: Promising in mice, but there are zero human hair-loss trials.

routes.name: Onion juice
routes.summary: A small trial showed regrowth — but for patchy alopecia areata, not pattern hair loss.

routes.name: Omega-3 (fish oil)
routes.summary: One density trial exists, but it tested a fish-oil-plus-antioxidant blend — benefit can't be pinned on omega-3.

routes.name: Ashwagandha
routes.summary: Lowers stress hormones, but no study has measured a hair outcome — the link is mechanism-only.

routes.name: Iron (ferritin support)
routes.summary: Helps shedding only if a blood test shows low ferritin — blanket dosing risks iron overload.

routes.name: Vitamin D
routes.summary: Worth correcting only if measured low — there's no proof it regrows hair in people who aren't deficient.

routes.name: Vitamin B12
routes.summary: Worth correcting only if measured low — deficiency is uncommon and supplementing without a low result does nothing for hair.
